title: 行为经济干预
text: “传统的理性人假设已无法解释现实中个体的决策偏差。”这位教授在讲座中如此地阐述。行为经济学通过研究认知局限，揭示了人类在面对复杂选择时常受启发式思维影响。这种倾向导致个体往往偏离最优解，进而产生次优结果。为了修正上述偏差，政策制定者引入了助推机制。该方法并不强制禁绝特定选项，而是通过优化选择架构来引导公众。例如，默认选项的设定能显著提升器官捐献的登记率。这种微小的调整利用了人类的惰性，从而实现了社会福利的最大化。框架效应同样是干预策略的核心。信息呈现方式的不同会直接改变人们对风险的感知。当损失被强调而非收益时，个体倾向于采取规避行为。政府利用此心理特性，在节能减排政策中设计对比方案。通过展示邻里间的能耗差异，激发竞争心理以降低整体用电量。此外，损失厌恶理论表明，失去某物的痛苦远大于获得同等价值的快乐。因此，将激励措施转化为潜在损失，往往比单纯提供奖金更有效。这种精准的干预手段降低了行政成本，同时提高了执行效率。然而，助推政策必须在透明度与家长主义之间寻求平衡。过度干预可能侵犯公民的自主选择权。因此，伦理审查成为了学术界讨论的焦点。未来的公共管理应当将心理学洞察与制度设计有机结合。这种跨学科路径为解决社会顽疾提供了新视角。通过科学地引导而非强制，社会治理将迈向更高维度。

questions.prompt: According to the professor quoted at the start of the text, what is wrong with the traditional 'rational person' assumption?
options: It cannot explain the decision biases seen in real individuals
It is too complicated to apply in policy
It works well for economic markets but not psychology
It has been mathematically proven false

questions.prompt: How does a 'nudge' approach differ from forbidding options outright, according to the text?
options: It guides people by optimizing the choice architecture rather than banning specific options
It legally bans harmful options while allowing beneficial ones
It relies purely on financial penalties
It requires a public referendum before implementation

questions.prompt: What example does the text give of a nudge that raises organ-donation registration rates?
options: Setting a default enrollment option
Offering large cash rewards to donors
Making donation legally mandatory
Publicizing celebrity donor testimonials

questions.prompt: According to loss aversion theory as described in the text, how does losing something compare to gaining something of equal value?
options: Losing causes far more pain than gaining the same value brings pleasure
Losing and gaining produce roughly equal emotional impact
Gaining brings more pleasure than losing brings pain
Loss aversion applies only to financial decisions

questions.prompt: What tension does the text say nudge policy must balance?
options: Transparency and paternalism
Profit and sustainability
Speed and accuracy
National security and free trade

patterns.title: 了 — completed action
patterns.explanation: Marks an action as completed (post-verbal 了) or a change of state (sentence-final 了). Worth re-reading whenever you spot it — the position shifts the meaning.

patterns.title: 是…的
patterns.explanation: Used to emphasise when, where, how, or by whom a past action happened. The 是 introduces the emphasised element; 的 closes the structure.

patterns.title: 被 passive
patterns.explanation: Marks the passive voice: the subject is acted upon. 被 introduces the agent (optional) and is followed by the verb.
